query: 'SELECT
    CAST(admission_id AS INT) AS admission_id,
    CAST(patient_id AS INT) AS patient_id,
    admission_date,
    CASE
        WHEN discharge_date < admission_date THEN NULL
        ELSE discharge_date
    END AS discharge_date,
    CAST(department AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS department,
    CAST(attending_doctor_id AS INT) AS attending_doctor_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_id)) AS admission_id,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(a.patient_id)) AS patient_id,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_date)), 23),
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_date)), 101),
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_date)), 10),
            TRY_PARSE(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.admission_date)) AS DATE USING 'en-US')
        ) AS admission_date,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.discharge_date)), 23),
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.discharge_date)), 101),
            TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(a.discharge_date)), 10),
            TRY_PARSE(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.discharge_date)) AS DATE USING 'en-US')
        ) AS discharge_date,
        CASE LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.department)))
            WHEN 'cardiology' THEN 'Cardiology'
            WHEN 'cardiolgy' THEN 'Cardiology'
            WHEN 'cardio' THEN 'Cardiology'
            WHEN 'emergency' THEN 'Emergency'
            WHEN 'emergancy' THEN 'Emergency'
            WHEN 'er' THEN 'Emergency'
            WHEN 'general surgery' THEN 'General Surgery'
            WHEN 'generalsurgery' THEN 'General Surgery'
            WHEN 'gen surg' THEN 'General Surgery'
            WHEN 'neurology' THEN 'Neurology'
            WHEN 'nuerology' THEN 'Neurology'
            WHEN 'neuro' THEN 'Neurology'
            WHEN 'oncology' THEN 'Oncology'
            WHEN 'oncologyy' THEN 'Oncology'
            WHEN 'onco' THEN 'Oncology'
            WHEN 'orthopedics' THEN 'Orthopedics'
            WHEN 'orthopaedics' THEN 'Orthopedics'
            WHEN 'ortho' THEN 'Orthopedics'
            WHEN 'pediatrics' THEN 'Pediatrics'
            WHEN 'paediatrics' THEN 'Pediatrics'
            WHEN 'peds' THEN 'Pediatrics'
            ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(a.department))
        END AS department,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(a.attending_doctor_id)) AS attending_doctor_id
    FROM bronze.admissions a
    INNER JOIN silver.patients p
        ON CAST(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.patient_id)) AS INT) = p.patient_id
) AS t
WHERE admission_date IS NOT NULL',
